# Trump’s approval drops 2 points in 2 weeks: Reuters/Ipsos poll

by Max Rego - 08/17/26 4:56 PM ET

Link copied

####

NOW PLAYING

####

One-third of Americans approve of President Trump’s job performance, according to a new Reuters/Ipsos survey.

The poll, conducted from Friday through Monday, found that 33 percent of 1,166 respondents approved of the job Trump is doing, while 64 percent disapproved. The poll had a margin of error of 3 percentage points.
results.title: New survey shows President Trump's approval at 33 percent

However, Republicans still approve of Trump’s job as president, according to the poll, with 76% approving his job performance, down slightly from 85% recorded by the pollster in June.

The poll of 963 registered voters was taken July 23-27 and has a margin of error of 4.1.

# Donald Trump's job approval falls to 33%

August 11, 2026

Only one-third (33%) of Americans strongly or somewhat approve of how Donald Trump is handling his job as president, according to the latest Economist / YouGov Poll. That's the smallest share to ever approve of Trump's job handling in any Economist / YouGov Poll across both of Trump's terms. Meanwhile 62% disapprove of Trump, the most to ever do so. [...] Almost all Democrats disapprove of Trump's job performance: 4% approve and 95% disapprove, for a net approval of -91.
